caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object positioned vertically in the center of a plain, off-white or beige background. The object appears to be a key, colored in various shades of brown and dark gray suggesting a metallic, possibly rusted surface. The top part of the object is rectangular and slightly tapered. Below this, there is a notched section resembling the teeth of a key, running diagonally downward and to the right, with a hooked component protruding to the right. A straight, narrow shaft extends downward from the notched section and ends in a circular loop at the bottom. The object is shown in isolation, with no additional elements or background details, and a small, faint label or text reading "MARLY HANDLER" appears in the lower right area of the drawing.
title: Trammel
